SALES_COMPARISON._Comment:
see additional addenda The sales presented share similar amenities and are located within the same market area. Equal weight was given to each comp. The subjects style, quality and amenities are similar to other homes in the neighborhood. The comparable sales included were considered the best available and required the least adjustments of all potential comparable sales considered. All adjustments were based on available market data and consulting with local real estate professionals. No adjustments were made for sales concessions because no adjustments are necessary for those costs which are normally paid by sellers as a result of tradition or law in a market area. Normal distance guidelines were expanded in order to include similar homes as the subject. This is typical of appraisal assignments in the subjects area and is not considered adverse.
Adjustments were developed based on the estimated market-based contributory value of the respective property characteristics within the subject's competitive market. The gross living area adjustment was estimated at $50 to $70 per square foot, with $60 per square foot selected to reflect differences in living area between the subject and comparable sales. Site-size adjustments were considered at $1.50 to $2.00 per square foot of difference, with $2.00 per square foot selected provisionally based on the contributory value of additional usable site area. Comparable sales with superior pond or conservation views were considered for downward adjustments in the range of $7,500 to $15,000, with $10,000 selected where supported by market reaction. A separate bedroom adjustment was not applied solely for the difference between three and four bedrooms, as bedroom count alone does not necessarily result in a measurable difference in market value when overall living area and functional utility are similar. The subject has been extensively renovated, including updated kitchen and bathroom finishes, quartz countertops, luxury vinyl flooring, and other interior improvements. Certain comparable sales exhibit average condition with more dated finishes, including vinyl kitchen countertops and less modernized interior components. A condition and updating adjustment of $30,000 was selected for comparables exhibiting a difference in overall modernization, and is considered reasonable, subject to support from the available market data. The adjustment reflects the anticipated difference in buyer appeal and contributory market value rather than the cost of the improvements.The adjustments reflect estimated contributory market value and should be evaluated in conjunction with the overall comparability and adjusted sale prices of the comparable properties.
Analysis of recent comparable sales and current market data within the subject’s competitive market area indicates market values are currently relatively stable. This trend is supported by a review of sale dates, contract activity, and overall market conditions. Based on this analysis, no market condition adjustment was applied.
Analysis of recent comparable sales and current market data within the subject’s competitive market area indicates a slight decline in property values leading up to February 2026. However, data from February 2026 to the present reflects that values have stabilized, with no clear pattern of continued decline or increase observed. This trend is supported by a review of sale dates, contract activity, and overall market conditions. Based on this analysis, a modest downward market condition adjustment was applied to comparable sales with older sale dates to reflect current market value as of the effective date of the appraisal. One additional comparable sale was included to help establish the estimted market value of the subject.
